0022600002.text: The New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers in the first game of the 2026-27 season for both teams, since neither has played yet this year. Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision for New York, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles) and has Adem Bona (day-to-day, foot sprain) and Anfernee Simons (day-to-day, hamstring) as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 144-114 Knicks win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives New York a 55% chance to win.
